STORY-FEAT4-039.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
STORY-FEAT4-039.description: Define and standardize the response schema for provider detail lookup including NPI fields, taxonomy, address, and external links to ensure consistent downstream consumption by facade and tool router.

STORY-FEAT4-040.title: Implement External Link Enrichment (State Boards and Research Sites)
STORY-FEAT4-040.description: Enhance provider detail service to construct and attach validated external links including state medical board lookup URLs and research site references based on provider state and identifiers.

STORY-FEAT4-041.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Tool Router
STORY-FEAT4-041.description: Register provider detail lookup as an allowed tool in tool_router with validated input model and ensure proper dispatch, enabling conversational access through the chat interface.
